ops.text: (v) upon Customer's request, Kubient shall (A) provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Kubient's then-current rates; (B) within thirty (30) days of such request, return or make available for export all Requests, Content and other Customer data in Kubient's possession or control in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (C) thereafter delete such data from its systems, subject to routine backups and legal retention requirements, and certify such deletion in writing.

input.comment: [Playbook] Section 4(c) ends the Services and permits destruction of Confidential Information without any obligation to give our data back or help us migrate, so we have added a standard exit provision: up to six (6) months of transition assistance at Kubient's then-current rates, return or export of our data in a machine-readable format within thirty (30) days, and certified deletion thereafter. If six months is difficult, we can accept ninety (90) days of assistance provided the 30-day export and deletion certificate remain.
input.summary: Insert transition-assistance and data-return obligation into the effects-of-termination list.
